duration.text: The Hydraulic Engineering at China Agricultural University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Scanned copy of passport (the date of expiration should be later than December, 2025； applicants without passports will not be accepted.);(2) Visa information (only required for students in China);(3) Notarized final degree certificate or pre-graduation certificate;(4) Official undergraduate transcripts; If it is neither Chinese nor English, notarized Chinese or English version should be provided;(5) Certification of English proficiency (IELTS, TOEFL, certification of a bachelor’s degree or master’s degree taught in English， or other materials that can prove English language proficiency );(6) Study/Work experience (updated to application date)(7) Study plan in English or Chinese (no less than 1000 words);(8) Two reference letters (in Chinese or English) from two professors or associate professors with signatures ( reference letters have no fixed format but must have references’ signatures as well as their positions and titles.)(9) Foreigner Physical Examination Form (photocopy); it can be downloaded from http://www.csc.edu.cn/uploads/forms/foreinphy.pdf;(10) No criminal report ( issued by the public security department);(11) Published academic papers, patents obtained, or other research achievements （either photocopy or original）.

requirements.text: To be eligible, applicants must:(1) be a citizen of “Belt and Road” countries, be in good health mentally and physically, abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as campus rules and regulations, and respect Chinese customs.(2) be a bachelor’s degree holder and under the age of 35 when applying for master’s degree programs;(3) have relatively strong academic background in the field they intend to apply.(4) having a high level of English proficiency，such as having a bachelor’s degree taught in English, or TOEFL (iBT) score of 90 points at least, or IELTS score at least 6.0，
